title: TaskTakenData
description: Data of the task.taken event: the task in the event envelope was taken in a worktree of the project in the envelope, anew if its attempt is above 1.

attempt.description: Attempt of the task: 1, or the next one when a cancelled task is taken anew.

node.description: Start node of the scenario: the task is at it.

worktree.description: Absolute path of the worktree the task holds.

flow_commit.description: Hash of the commit that applied the flow of the task.

source.description: Who passed the title and the statement: operator or agent.
